blocks.faith.heading: Faith at the center, never forced
blocks.faith.body:
Some Christians wonder how IFS fits their faith. Our IFS-informed counselors work from a Christian understanding of the person, and they'll talk through any questions you have, including how IFS ideas sit alongside what Scripture teaches.

If you'd rather leave faith out, your counselor's care is just as thorough, and they follow your lead. [How faith works at Freedom](/christian-counseling)

sections.body: Internal family systems (IFS) therapy helps you understand the different "parts" of you, like the part that pushes you to keep going or the part still carrying an old hurt, and lead them from a calmer, more compassionate place. IFS was developed by family therapist Richard Schwartz.
sections.heading: What is IFS therapy?

sections.body: IFS sees the mind as made up of parts, each trying to help in its own way. Some parts protect you, like the critic, the worrier, or the part that numbs out. Others carry old pain. In IFS, you get to know these parts with curiosity instead of fighting them, so the protective ones can relax and the hurting ones can heal.
sections.heading: Every part of you has a reason

sections.body: Your counselor helps you notice a part, get to know what it's worried about, and understand what it's protecting. It's a gentle, conversational process, and nothing is forced. IFS is often used for trauma, anxiety, depression, shame, and inner conflict, and a growing body of research is studying its benefits.
sections.heading: Curious, compassionate, and at your pace
What IFS helps with
sections.body: [Trauma](/trauma-counseling), [anxiety](/anxiety-depression-counseling), [depression](/depression-counseling), shame, inner criticism, and feeling pulled in different directions.

sections.heading: Honest limits and training
sections.body: IFS is widely used, and its research base is still growing. Our counselors are IFS-informed: they use IFS ideas and practices within counseling, and Kasie is in IFS training. They aren't accredited IFS practitioners; if you're looking specifically for an accredited practitioner, the IFS Institute keeps a directory.

blocks.expect.heading: Your first session
blocks.expect.body: Your first session is about getting to know you and what's been hard. You won't be pushed into anything before you're ready. Sessions are in our Middletown office or online.
blocks.cost.body: We don't bill insurance, but you can pay with an HSA or FSA card, and we'll give you a superbill to submit for possible out-of-network reimbursement.
